reviews.text:
Dr. Gary Adams is a knowledgeable and caring professional—that’s the only reason I’m giving this place 2 stars instead of 1. Everything else about my experience has been dreadful.

I brought my dog in on a Friday for bloodwork, and the doctor said he’d call between Monday and Tuesday with the results. He never did. I started calling and emailing every day to follow up, and each time I was told they were busy and would reach out soon. I only got scraps of information, and only because I kept pushing.

My dog had started reacting to his medication, but things were improving—until he ran out. I ordered a refill online, and the prescription was rejected. I only found out through Chewy; no one from the clinic told me. When I called, I was assured that if I placed the order again, it would be approved right away. It wasn’t.

My dog has now been without his medication for a week. He screeches in pain every time he sits or stands, so he paces instead of resting, and he’s barely sleeping. I called again today and sent another email. Same answer: it would be handled soon. I hope they resolve this before the long weekend, because it’s agonizing to watch my dog suffer because of other people’s negligence. This clinic seems understaffed and unable to keep up with its own workload—but that shouldn’t come at the expense of my pet’s health. On top of it all, I paid over $500 and still can’t get a real response.

We took our senior cat to Shelter Veterinary on W Pico Blvd during a very stressful situation, and I’m grateful for the care and attention they gave her. Our first point of contact over the phone and in person was Steve- I cannot say enough great things about him. His demeanor and help was above and beyond. Doctor Adam was thorough, explained the findings clearly, reviewed the bloodwork and x-rays with us, and helped us understand the possible treatment paths without rushing us.

The staff was patient and compassionate with an older cat who was clearly uncomfortable and scared.

Pet emergencies are emotional and expensive, but I did feel they took care of our cat with great empathy. Very responsive via phone calls also.  Tabitha and Martha at the lobby main desk are exceptional. Thank you to the entire team for helping us through a difficult couple of days.
Excellent service they really took care of my dog with kindness and respect and very affordable as well
cats…
Clean, wonderful staff. Best vet My Cat Gang has ever had is there. We follow him wherever he goes and after our experience in December, it's a no-brainer anyway. I'm a happy cat mom here!

Excellent care with Dr. Adams, whom we've been going to for years. The vet techs are knowledgeable and empathetic. Summer, in the front office, has gone out of her way many times to get info for me.
The only reason I did not give 5 stars is because I wish they had an overnight tech for sick or post-surgical animals who have to stay there overnight.
12 years and 4 dogs examined, treated and vaccinated here. Highly recommended.
We recently took our dog Bella for an eye infection and dental work. They treated both and she is slowly getting better. Dr. Adam and the staff are friendly, they answer all your questions.

DO NOT COME HERE. This place sucks. If you adopt from West LA shelter ask them for the other offices that accept the free spay/neuter vouchers and avoid dealing with this place at all costs. They have you on hold forever, never return calls, never respond to voicemails. Receptionists/manager are rude and unhelpful. This place is always so chaotic I can't imagine how they treat the animals behind closed doors. Nobody ever knows anything when you ask them a question. Super long wait times. I can go on and on with my complaints and it seems like a lot of people have had similar experiences here. Not sure why they can't seem to get it together.
Friendly place so many dogs who need assistance. 😔 …

Man, this place is quite the place. They give your pup a shot and don't tell you anything about reactions to expect. No one seems to know what's going on with anything when we have visited and they just tried to bait and switch us on a service charge. 3 times the quote we got when we made the appointment. This is not a good place and there are so many more options. Do yourself and your loved one (pet) a favor and go to somewhere else.

It's time to publicly shame companies who do not give prices over the phone because they are either overpriced or change the price based on how you look when you come in. I'm trying to get my female cat spayed and the receptionist refused to give me even a price range. In what world can you not provide any pricing and want a patient to spend hours out of their day going to an appointment just to find out it's overpriced but hoping the effort they spent so far is a sunk cost and they might as well spend it? Go somewhere else.
Our favorite veterinary ! The best team! Very helpful every time and not pricey

Been going 2 Shelter Vet 4 years & I like Dr Vardi & most of the staff, though it’s messed me up financially. It’s not their fault my cats have health issues, it’s just when every visit ends up being a minimum of 1k & more like 2k / I have to go every few months it’s a lot.
I did everything 2 keep my Littles from dying. I spent close to 10k only 4 him 2 die anyway in a couple days. It was horrible & traumatic. The process from shelter vet 2 them telling me 2 go 2 an ER th@ pushed me 2 put him down & she did it while he was trying 2 get into my arms so he collapsed (she didn’t even wait for him 2 get 2 me.. I won’t ever forget that) 2 the cremation place th@ they partner w/ who presented him 2 me in an unnatural pose where his legs were stuck out in crazy directions from him dying th@ way (they didn’t even make sure he looked peaceful or anything) etc. it was one of the worst experiences I’ve ever had. (Not saying that’s all their fault) But after that it felt like they kinda got Ill do anything Im at all able 2 help my cats (although I have chronic illness myself & have 2 be on a very low fixed income atm because of it). thats when every bill from Shelter Vet started being up 2 2k.
Coincidence? Sure maybe, but either way it became 2 much.
So I asked them if they could help me by referring me 2 some organizations th@ help ppl like me pay 4 my companion animals bills. But they refused saying I have 2 refer myself. Well most of them don’t work th@ way making it impossible 4 me.
I was at a loss of what 2 do.
But the final straw was the new manager.
Im sure she’s a decent person but I wouldn’t know because every interaction I’ve had with her she is either fake smiley but patronizing as heck mixed with sarcasm or shes  straight up argumentative b4 she even has the facts.
For instance I called 2 pay over the phone (like I did a lot & was told to do when I was able) 4 my cats meds. She immediately said I had 2 have another appt if I wanted my meds & that she wouldnt process it over the phone. I tried 2 explain th@ I already had this arranged but she kept arguing w/ me until I got anxious because I was super ill & couldn’t come in 4 yet another expensive doctors visit, especially when this had already been approved. She finally gets what I’m saying but instead of apologizing or at least owning th@ she was wrong, she instead told me I didn’t say it right so it was my fault. Thats how she is each time we speak. She will immediately cut me off & shut me down only 2 realize a lot of the time I knew what I was saying & she just didnt listen. But never once has she taken an ounce of responsibility 4 this.
Im looking for a new vet because of the things mentioned (I found a low cost clinic but still looking 4 a full vet) which is a shame.
Today I called 2 ask a question about billing of the meds I got & the moment she knew who I was she was rude. I said “hi there I have a question” & she cut me off & said “oh Do you have a question? Is it about something or some service in the past because didn’t you get a new vet??…” she kinda rambled on 4 a sec & trailed off.
What is that? I told her I actually don’t have a full vet yet because I’m hospitalized atm & she was like “OH NO! well let’s hope you’re okay” which came across very sarcastic but I could just be sensitive since she had just ran over me when I just said I needed 2 ask something.
I asked my question, she said no (I knew she would, she never said yes to anything without a struggle), I thanked her & hung up.
It’s been a bad time for awhile now & I wasn’t going 2 say anything since I was moving on, but her last little jab just really was the last straw 4 me.
So even though I was very happy to have Dr Vardi as a Dr 4 the time I did, the unwillingness 2 fill out some paper work so I could get help & being talked down 2 by the management every time I reach out makes this kinda out of my hands at this point.

PS we worked it out. Still way 2 much $ 4 me but I guess w/ no insurance/older babies, it’s going to cost you your soul to try and keep them alive in this town. What can you do..

I have been going here for years
The Vet is excellent 👌
I highly recommend Shelter Vet
You need an appointment …

If I could go negative stars I would. I adopted the most beautiful sweet French Bulldog from the shelter but had to have her fixed before we could take her home. Ok fine the shelter sets this up with this establishment so ok let's do it. I get a call before the procedure that they recommend I do blood work and other things coming out to almost $400 in unexpected fees. I unfortunately had to pass because I did not have these funds at this time but they assured me everything would be ok and I would be able to pick my dog up at 4pm. I get a call at 2 pm stating they are very sorry but my dog did not survive the procedure but if I had paid the nearly $400 that would have provided them the info to use different anesthesia or something. Basically saying she may have survived if I paid the money. These dogs are known to have breathing issues during anesthesia that require extra attention during surgeries but I guess they didn't account for this. The fact they blamed me for not paying for blood work as the root cause of the death of this beautiful animal is just beyond all that is reasonable and ethical. DO NOT TAKE YOUR FRENCHIE HERE. DEATH WAS THE OUTCOME FOR US. My family has been completely traumatized by the actions of this vet.

Terrible customer service , receptionist is very rude I’d recommend having someone else answer the phones. I called to ask if they neuter dogs and she spent more time refusing to answer my question than just a simple yes or no.

They spayed my 4 month old puppy did a horrible job she got aspirated pneumonia from the breathing tube they put down her throat. Cost me $1,500. At my regular vet with many office visits tests & medication. Had to be on antibiotics for a month. The doctor also didn’t sew her incision correctly she has something circular the size of a dime feels like rubber band popping out of it under her skin after it healed. Don’t go here!!

I’ve been coming to this vet for over 10 years for my cats and I’ve seen many doctors come through this establishment. I am sad to say that they were much more caring in the past and I really miss some of them. The newer vet is kind of cold towards the pets and humans coming in. They mixed up one of my cats tests for feline aids and told me it was negative and then 5 minutes later said it was actually positive. I asked which it was and was told I don’t know. We need to do the test again to be sure. They told me I needed to pay the test fee again to have it redone and it was ANOTHER several hundred dollars. This was during the same visit when I had just paid ( was about to pay at the end of visit) they refused to retest her without paying and that it was in fact positive. I really feel like now with the new care professionals here I’m nickled and dimed. He could have simply retested her since I was already being charged for it and they mixed up the tests and were unsure. I’ve worked in a vet office after college and it happens sometimes as human error but don’t try to make the pet parents pay for your mistake. I had the cat tested at VCA where I now take her and it was negative . They did it for free when I told them what happened.
Dr V is the best vet ever he cares for each and every one of my dogs.

Adopted a pet from the shelter next door… was told I needed to wait to pick up my pet two days later from this vet because it needed to be sterilized first. They never called me, so I called them and they told me to come in around 4:30pm. I …
very courteous receptionist, quick response time, I needed some flea medicine for a friend's dog and called them and they were able to have it ready for me within an hour.

My client adopted a sweet little dog, 1 1/2 years old. The shelter said that she could not take her home until she was spayed, and that she had to be spayed at the veterinary place right next door because they had a contract. …

Stopped by to see if kibbles were available.
Katherine, whom I checked in with, kindly brought kibbles, treats and a towel for Hügø! …
